evidence.note: Flat white background with no texture, grain or grid lines; nodes are large white rounded cards with soft shadows.
Title is large dark serif type; body column is large sans in mid-grey, clearly readable.
Arrows are about 2-3 px strokes in grey, blue and red with clear arrowheads; node labels are generous dark sans.
At the small window, arrows thin out and the check badges become small, but node labels and the callout text remain legible.
Grey body text is smaller here but still readable with adequate contrast on white.
Insight pop-over is an opaque card with large serif text; background blur is intentional de-emphasis, not grain.

rationale: The slide relies on flat colour, big soft cards and generous type, with no texture, grain or hairline grids. The thinnest elements are the 2-3 px diagram arrows and small check badges at 1288x598, which thin out but carry no text and stay visible. Nothing essential would be erased by compression, so it matches the pass descriptor.
